fields.Name: AIUsageUnpricedAudit
fields.UserQuestion: Which completed AI runs have not been priced and need pricing tiers or investigation?
fields.Description: Surfaces completed AI prompt runs where IsPriced = 0 (parallel parents excluded), newest first, with a diagnostic explanation for why each run was unpriced (unmeasured, or missing pricing tier).
fields.TechnicalDescription: Quality and audit query over [__mj].vwAIUsageFacts for IsCompleted = 1 AND IsPriced = 0 AND IsParallelParent = 0, bounded by an optional start/end window on the base RunAt column and a row cap (maxRows, default 500), ordered by RunAt descending. Emits UnpricedReason to assist administrators in backfilling model cost configurations.
